ontology.name: Pizza Ontology
ontology.description: The classic OWL teaching ontology — pizza types, toppings, and bases. Adapted from the University of Manchester's Pizza tutorial.

entityTypes.name: Pizza
entityTypes.description: A pizza with a base and one or more toppings

entityTypes.name: PizzaBase
entityTypes.description: The base of a pizza — thin crust, deep pan, or stuffed crust

entityTypes.name: PizzaTopping
entityTypes.description: An ingredient placed on top of a pizza

entityTypes.name: Country
entityTypes.description: The country of origin for a named pizza style

entityTypes.name: SpicinessLevel
entityTypes.description: The spiciness classification of a topping (mild, medium, hot)

relationships.name: hasBase
relationships.description: A pizza has exactly one base

relationships.name: hasTopping
relationships.description: A pizza has one or more toppings

relationships.name: hasCountryOfOrigin
relationships.description: The country a named pizza originates from

relationships.name: hasSpiciness
relationships.description: The spiciness classification of a topping
